May 15, 2016

The PRSC has announced its plans for Science and Technology R&D over the next 10 years. This plan will involve several areas of science and technology applications. Currently, focus is on developing the plan further and investigating what will be required in the way of money and time to achieve these preliminary goals.

Robotics and Automation:

  • Become a major competitor in the industrial robotics market by the end of the 10 year plan. The Shenzhen Robotics Co-Op has been established and expects to begin commissioning robot systems in the South China market by the end of the year. Plans also involve marketing this technology to foreign countries in an effort to compete internationally with the likes of Motoman, Fanuc, Kuka, and ABB.

  • A future robotics research facility, has started in Chongqing to investigate future robotics applications particularly in the medical and military and fields.

Power Generation

  • The Guangdong Nuclear Power Group will continue construction of Generation II+ and III reactors at current plants located around the coast. In reaction to the unfortunate incident at Fukushima, future Generation III and III+ plants will be focused more on inland regions of the country. Researchers are also investigating how to handle spent fuel. Plans call for Nuclear Power to account for 150 GW of capacity by the year 2030. This will involve research into Generation IV reactors.

  • Continued focus on research into renewable energy sources. Investment into solar, wind, and hydro.

Medical

  • More funding will be allocated to medical research facilities, primarily in the areas of genetic, stem cell, pharmaceutical, and biotech research.

Transportation

  • R&D into domestic built commercial jets.

  • R&D into high speed rail to interconnect the country.

Space Exploration

  • Development of a new space program. Currently focused on building space faring vehicles with the aim of building a space station by 2030.
